items.description:

Any light showers at first quickly clearing, then dry and sunny. Patchy light rain and drizzle later in night.


##Temperature##

0.5-2


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

NW


##Wind##

NW 15-20 at first, 20-25 in a few places, but veering and decreasing North or NE 10-15 during morning. Backing NW later in day, then West 10-15 overnight, 15-20 in places.


##Visibility##

Good. Patchy hill fog later.


##Comments##

Strong winds in a few places at first.
